Jess Hagman is the Social Sciences Research Librarian and Associate Professor at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. Her research interests include academic library services for graduate students, qualitative research methods, and research methods trainer.

## Education

### Ohio University \| Athens, OH 

MA in Organizational Communication, 2015

### University of Wisconsin-Madison \| Madison, WI 

MA in Library & Information Science, 2008

BA in History & Sociology, 2006

## Experience

**University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign**

Social Sciences Research Librarian and Assistant Professor, 2019-2026

**Ohio University**

Social Media Coordinator & Subject Librarian for Scripps College, 2014-2019

Reference & Instruction Librarian, 2008-2014
